item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Was Lindsay Clancy in her right mind? Defense now highlights a key question at murder trial
item.description: Lindsay Clancy’s mental health is at the center of her murder trial. The defense concedes that Clancy committed the crime, but says she wasn’t in her right mind when it happened.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US Rep Byron Donalds wins GOP nod for governor in Florida, to face former Rep. David Jolly
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds won Republican nomination for Florida governor and former Rep. David Jolly won Democratic nomination on Tuesday, setting the stage to replace outgoing Gov. Ron DeSantis.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] David Jolly is the projected winner of Florida's Democratic gubernatorial primary
item.description: Jolly was born in Dunedin and served in the U.S. House of Representatives as a Republican from the 13th District from 2014 to 2017.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bryon Donalds the projected winner of Republican gubernatorial primary
item.description: Donalds was endorsed by President Donald Trump and held a commanding lead heading into election night against a large field of Republican lawmakers, including Lt. Governor Jay Collins.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete Mayor's race: Ken Welch, Charlie Crist head to runoff election
